text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it initiated coverage of Action Performance Companies Inc with an outperform rating for the intermediate and long terms and set an intermediate target price of $26.

-- The rating is based on the company's solid position to capitalize on the tremendous growth prospects of the National Association of Stock Car Auto Racing (NASCAR) through Action Performance's die-cast and pewter miniature vehicle replicas, EVEREN said.
-- EVEREN set the earnings estimate for fiscal 1998 at $0.97 a share and the estimate for 1998 at $1.37.
-- Action Performance shares were up 1/8 Wednesday at 19-1/8.
